claim: total assets at Google came to $502 million in the fiscal second quarter of 2025.
summary: Google's fiscal Q2 2025 ended June 2025, but total assets were on the order of $500 billion, not $502 million. The value claim is wrong by ~1000x.

sub_claims.text: Google's fiscal second quarter of 2025 ended June 30, 2025
sub_claims.note: Alphabet (parent of Google) uses a calendar fiscal year, so fiscal Q2 2025 is the quarter ending June 30, 2025.

sub_claims.text: Google total assets were $502 million in fiscal Q2 2025
sub_claims.note: Alphabet total assets in mid-2025 were on the order of ~$500 billion, not $502 million; the claimed $502 million understates scale by a factor of ~1000, likely a million vs billion unit error.
